column2: The §YWinds of Chaos§! grow stronger with your raiding!
The priests are clear. For now the Winds of Chaos blow very weakly, but they may grow stronger while war, sickness and strife rage across the mortal world.
The omens of doom have grown of late. They are not yet apocalyptic, but the Winds of Chaos are rising, though for now they are still weak.
The priesthood is divided, but its auguries say that the Winds of Chaos now blow moderately strong. Daemons find it much easier to enter the world.
Strange storms afflict the world, sometimes accompanied by the laughter of daemons, and other unnatural portents grow more common. The signs are clear: the Winds of Chaos blow strong.
Dark clouds of unnatural colour hang over the northern horizon, and the winds carry the laughter and cries of daemons. Dark dreams trouble your people, and the priests say the End Times are near.

Chaos has broken through!
For millennia the Great Vortex of Ulthuan held back the tide that poured from the shattered Polar Gates. Now the Vortex has failed, the geomantic web of the Slann is torn apart, and the stuff of Chaos floods the world, drowning every living creature in madness, death and ruin.
No refuge is left. The whole world will be consumed by the raging energies of the Warp, until nothing remains and Chaos devours itself as well.
And so the fate that has awaited the world since the Old Ones left it has come to pass.
